panel.title: SONOFF TRV Schedule Manager
panel.about_text:
Use this editor to view, create and manage the weekly schedules stored on your TRV. Other TRV settings and controls are available on the ZHA device page in Home Assistant.
Fetch an existing daily schedule to review or edit it, or create a new schedule from scratch. Choose its temperature periods, then apply the schedule to the desired days. Select the destination schedule and, if multiple TRVs are available, copy the schedule to a different TRV.
panel.edit_existing: About loading, editing and sending schedules
panel.edit_step_1: With the TRV selected, choose a schedule to fetch and edit an existing plan.
panel.edit_step_2: Select a day and press Fetch & edit.
panel.edit_step_3: Edit or add periods, up to 12 per day.
panel.edit_step_4: Choose the destination days or use presets. In Send to, select the desired destination.
panel.edit_important: Selecting a schedule to fetch and edit immediately switches the TRV to that schedule.
panel.new_step_1: With the TRV selected, choose a schedule to create a new plan.
panel.new_step_2: Set period 1 and add more periods as needed, up to 12 per day.
panel.new_step_3: Choose the days for the new schedule or use presets.
panel.new_important: Selecting a schedule to create a new plan immediately switches the TRV to that schedule.
panel.select_trv: Select the TRV you want to manage
panel.new_schedule_hint: A new schedule starts with period 1 at 00:00 and can contain up to 12 periods. Start times use 30-minute increments.
panel.fetch_destination_hint: Select the days to apply the schedule to. Use CLEAR to reset the selection.
panel.no_devices: No supported SONOFF TRV devices found. ZHA may still be starting.
panel.status_new_schedule: New schedule. Choose target days and add periods.
panel.status_choose_fetch: Choose a day and fetch its schedule.
panel.status_loaded: Schedule loaded: {day}. Periods defined: {count} of 12. You can now edit, delete or add periods.
panel.status_writing: Selected days: {count}. Transferring and verifying may take a while. Please resist the urge to click things and wait.
panel.status_verified: {days}: All done. Schedule successfully written to the TRV and confirmed by reading it back. The urge to click may now be indulged.
panel.status_unverified: {days}: Schedule written, but verification was inconclusive.
panel.validation_select_day: Select at least one target day.
panel.validation_time_step: Period {period}: start time must use 30-minute increments.
panel.validation_temperature: Period {period}: temperature must be 5-30 °C in 0.5 °C steps.
panel.validation_period_order: Period {period} must be later than period {previous}.
